title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the journey towards happiness, prosperity, and well-being through righteousness
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting the journey towards happiness, prosperity, and well-being through righteousness and noble guidance.
The Prime Minister wrote on X;
"सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिम् ।
दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसो अस्रवन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये॥"
May human beings seek refuge in the ever-protecting earth and the vast, boundless heavens, which provide secure shelter and uphold righteousness. Freed from sin and guided along the auspicious path, may we embark upon the divine boat, strong, well-crafted, and equipped with noble oars, and safely cross over to happiness, prosperity, and well-being.
सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिम् । दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसो अस्रवन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये॥ pic.twitter.com/MCcDD8JyeP — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 22, 2026
